info.title: harnfig
info.description: Declaratively install Agent Skills from GitHub for Cursor, Codex, and Claude.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Declaratively install Agent Skills from GitHub.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install configured skills for the selected agents.

options.name: --scope
options.description: Override installation scope: project or user.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Resolve and validate without writing files. [default: False]

options.name: --frozen
options.description: Require harnfig.lock to match without changes. [default: False]

options.name: --update
options.description: Refresh mutable refs and rewrite harnfig.lock. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace unmanaged or locally modified destinations. [default: False]
